page.overview:
What is Free Speech for the Dumb?

Free Speech for the Dumb is the Disc 1 first song from 1998's album Garage, Inc. It was written by Garry Maloney, Kevin Morris, Tony Roberts, and Roy Wainwright, with a length of 2:35.

This song was originally released by Discharge in 1982 on the Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing album. Metallica’s version was recorded in Sep-Oct 1998, at The Plant Studios in Sausalito, CA.
